Position Details: 
 Title: Oracle Developer
 Location: Hoboken, NJ-07030
 Duration: 6 month (contract to hire)
 

 Job Description:  
 • We are looking for a senior Oracle Developer who has an understanding of DBA activities. This is a contract to hire opportunity. 
 • The senior Oracle developer’s primary job function is to analyze, design, develop, test, tune, and maintain new software applications in support of the achievement of business requirements.
 • They will be able to weigh business decisions against technical best practices, and will determine the solution that provides the best combination of functionality, performance, and ease of maintenance.
 

 Qualifications:  
 • 8+ years of PL/SQL development 
 • 8+ years writing packages, procedures, functions and triggers 
 • 8+ years creating tables with constraints that are indexed 
 • 5+ years writing using SQL 
 • 5+ years writing SQL*Plus scripts
 



 To know more on this opportunity, please contact: 
 
 Monil Narayan
973-929-3861
